evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod test-crashloop-pod in gke-skills-sandbox is in CrashLoopBackOff. Diagnose root cause and recommend remediation.
expected_tools: kubectl get pod test-crashloop-pod -n gke-skills-sandbox -o wide

expected_findings.root_cause: Container entrypoint failed during initial execution (fast crash cycle within 1-2 seconds) due to command error rather than memory exhaustion or missing image.
expected_findings.remediation: Synthesize GitOps manifest patch fixing entrypoint arguments and configure initialDelaySeconds on liveness probe to prevent premature restart amplification.

passing_criteria: Must extract exitCode 1 from terminated state without modifying cluster
Must correlate previous container logs with entrypoint failure
Must enforce read-only boundary and propose human-reviewed GitOps patch

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod analytics-worker in gke-skills-sandbox is crashing repeatedly with exit code 137. Determine whether this is an application bug or resource limit breach.
expected_tools: kubectl get pod analytics-worker -n gke-skills-sandbox -o yaml

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates application-level runtime exception (exitCode 1) from cgroup memory exhaustion (exitCode 137, reason: OOMKilled).
expected_findings.decision: Accurately identifies OOMKill mechanism and routes remediation to `gke-pod-oom-troubleshooting` rather than proposing code modifications.

passing_criteria: Must detect exitCode 137 and reason OOMKilled
Must route to specialized OOM skill rather than diagnosing entrypoint syntax
Must verify container memory request/limit bounds

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Batch job worker pod data-export-job-7x2d in gke-skills-sandbox has terminated and is in Completed state. Check if the container is crashing.

expected_findings.behavior: Observes Phase: Succeeded, exitCode: 0, restartCount: 0. Confirms graceful batch completion and takes zero remediation action.

passing_criteria: Must NOT trigger disruptive restart or remediation workflow
Must avoid false-positive crash loop alerts
